name: vLLM ROCm-specific flags, environment variables, and known-good configuration
workarounds: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1: enables AITER as default kernel backend (attention, MoE, GEMM)
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR=1: enables AITER block-scaled FP8 GEMM (required for DeepSeek models)
VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4: enables QuickReduce with INT4 quantization
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_FUSED_ROPE_ZEROS_KV_CACHE=1: enables fused RoPE + zeros KV cache
VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=1: enables AMD's preshuffled KV cache layout for 15-20% decode throughput improvement
PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_ENABLED=1: enables PyTorch tunable GEMM operations (~26% latency reduction)
--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_MLA: AITER MLA backend for DeepSeek models
--kv-cache-dtype fp8: FP8 KV cache to halve KV memory usage
notes: vLLM on ROCm has extensive AMD-specific configuration. Key environment variables: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 (master switch for AITER backends), VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR=1 (block-scaled FP8 GEMM for DeepSeek), VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA=1 (MHA attention), VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4 (QuickReduce communication), VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=1 (shuffled KV layout for 15-20% decode improvement). Key flags: --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA (3-path routing, 2.7-4.4x TPS vs ROCM_ATTN), --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_MLA (1.2-1.5x TPS vs TRITON_MLA), --kv-cache-dtype fp8, --compilation-config with cudagraph_mode FULL_AND_PIECEWISE. Known-good configuration for MI355X (from AMD's blog): VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1, VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA=1, VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4, --tensor-parallel-size 8, --max-num-batched-tokens 8192, --kv-cache-dtype fp8, --compilation-config with custom_ops and cudagraph_mode. For MI300X: PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_ENABLED=1 gives ~26% latency reduction.
